text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I was helping out at a walk rally 
event.
Several Tracen Academy horse girls, 
including Meisho Doto, were participating 
in the rally.

text_block_list.name: Participant Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Are we not at the next checkpoint yet~? 
Let's take a break, I'm at my limit 
already~...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then feast your eyes upon my sun-like 
radiance! Vitality shall surge through 
your entire body!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-As expected of Opera O-san... You don't 
look tired at all...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! For I am the Supreme Overlord! 
As the bearer of mighty power, it is my 
duty to guide all!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I shall hasten ahead! To blaze 
the trail, carve footsteps in history,
and 
become the shining beacon guiding you 
forward!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eeeh? P-Please wait, Opera O-san――

text_block_list.name: Participant Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
S-She really took off... I want to chase 
after her, but there's no way~...

text_block_list.name: Participant Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Well, Opera O-san will be fine,
right? She 
has way more stamina than any of us.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-But...
I-I'll go after Opera O-san after 
all...!

text_block_list.name: Participant Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Got it, good luck. We'll catch up once we 
get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Are these Opera O-san's footprints? If I 
follow them, I should catch up...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? T-These footprints... They're 
heading in a completely different 
direction from the route?! O-Oh no, did 
Opera O-san get lost...?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I have to catch up quickly...! Someone 
like me won't be much help, but e-even 
so...!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what tragic fate is this! To think 
that I, of all people, have lost sight of 
the path I must tread...!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Nay, impossible! Perish the thought. 
Indeed, I must have been led here by 
destiny itself...!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
――You ask why? Because this scenery 
awakens it within me. My origin, the 
cherished memories of my youth...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
When gazing into the water's surface,
what reflects back is none other than my 
radiant self, blessed by all the world! 
Just one glance fills me with boundless 
courage――

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Hence, there is no issue whatsoever. 
Come, the march of the Supreme Overlord 
must never halt――
Opera O-san!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness, I finally found you~...!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Dotou! Whatever brings you here...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I was looking for you, Opera O-san... I 
thought you might have gotten lost... I-I 
got worried, and, um...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Opera O-san? U-Um... are you alright? 
Did you hurt yourself anywhere...?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No... there is no problem.
I am quite fine 
now. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You have my gratitude, Dotou. And yet,
you 
truly are reckless, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry. But once I thought about 
wanting to stay by your side,
Opera O-san, 
I just couldn't sit still.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Leaving you all alone, Opera O-san... was 
the one thing I couldn't bear.
That's why, 
um...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...? What is the meaning of that 
outstretched hand, Dotou...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, so we don't get separated... L-Let's 
hold hands! If it bothers you,
please tell 
me right away!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Haha, very well. Bothersome? Far from 
it. I shall gladly accept your proposal!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah... there's the checkpoint! Everyone 
else and the Trainer are there too!

text_block_list.name: Participant Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
You two, thank goodness~! We heard you 
hadn't arrived yet and got so worried~!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My sincere apologies...! To think I 
subjected you all to the tragedy of
losing 
sight of my brilliance, even for a brief 
moment...!
choice_data_list: Are you hurt anywhere?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, there is not a single blemish upon 
my beauty. And that, too, is thanks to 
Dotou's presence!
choice_data_list: You're not hurt, are you?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-What...
but I didn't do anything special 
at all...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for such modesty. After 
all, you granted me the precious 
experience of walking with my hand guided 
by another!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Awawa, I-I'm so sorry...! I knew it,
I was 
being way too presumptuous...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm overwhelmed,
but... if I was able to 
be of any help, I'm glad...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though lacking in confidence as always, 
Meisho Doto seemed to feel a quiet pride 
in having supported everyone...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Now it is my turn as the 
Supreme Overlord to guide you all
steadily 
to the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O wore her usual composed
smile. 
Yet her voice carried a gentler tone than 
usual...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu,
indeed. Let us simply say that I was 
able to reaffirm the worth of something 
truly irreplaceable.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't really understand, but... as 
long as Opera O-san is happy, I'm glad...
